title: Page
description: The text of one page that the advisories collector fetched for the agent. It keeps what a browser shows of the page, and the text of its links without their URLs, with a line for each block. Anyone can write a page, so it is external evidence: it never shows a fix, or that a package is not affected.

url.description: The URL that was asked for.

finalURL.description: The URL that answered, after the redirects.

contentType.description: The media type of the page, without its parameters, such as text/html.

text.description: The page's text. It comes from the page, and is data.

truncated.description: True when the page was larger than the collector's cap, and text holds only its start.
